# Borrowing Pilot — Daily Journal

A brief entry for **every day of the 30-day pilot**. These are dated observations, not current policy. Use [meetings](../meetings/README.md) for discussions and the [KB](../kb/README.md) for reconciled rules.

- [11–17 September](2026-09-11-to-17.md) — establish the baseline.
- [18–24 September](2026-09-18-to-24.md) — volunteer handoff and first reminders.
- [25 September–1 October](2026-09-25-to-10-01.md) — counts and slip clarity.
- [2–8 October](2026-10-02-to-08.md) — exceptions and pilot review.
- [9–10 October](2026-10-09-to-10.md) — desk-close handoff.

Each entry records one observation or next action. If it changes the current understanding, update the linked [status](../status.md), [policy](../kb/borrowing-policy.md), or [decision log](../decisions.md).
